title: 窗光上方保护路线
description: 油画暖光里，完整双人上方保护场景与大点路线形成从容节奏。

art_direction.medium: linocut print with indigo shadows and ochre highlights
art_direction.scene: Create an original oil-painting illustration of a fictional adult climbing an easy indoor top-rope line beside tall sunlit windows. Broad blue handholds and generous footholds support a natural upright movement. Use a wide horizontal composition showing the opaque-clothed climber, correctly fitted harness and proper tie-in through designated points, continuous rope to the overhead anchor, and descending strand to a competent harnessed adult belayer. The belayer stands on a clear floor, watches attentively, and maintains the brake hand down on the brake strand beside the belay device. Paint rich ochre light and blue-gray impasto shadows. Show believable rope routing and adult anatomy. No free solo, lettering, logos, or slack loop.
